original_benchmark.notes: HealthBench Professional (OpenAI, arXiv 2604.27470): 525 real clinician conversations graded against physician-written rubric items by an LLM judge (gpt-5.4-2026-03-05, reasoning low).

harbor_adapter.notes: Oracle passes on all 525 tasks (Harbor 0.25.0). Parity on the 150-task stratified subset (--split parity), three runs per side, Harbor 0.26.0 with the separate verifier; the run ranges overlap. Parity cost: about $15, of which $2.90 is agent cost reported by Claude Code and the rest the gpt-5.4 judge (about $2 per run of 150 tasks), 10-task sanity runs included.
